newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Frome Co issues 9.5 bln esc Navigator bond.
newsitem.headline: Frome Co issues 9.5 bln esc Navigator bond.

text.p: The following issue was announced by lead manager Banco Portugues de Investimento (BPI).
BORROWER: Frome Company AMT: 9.5 billion escudos
INTEREST: Six-month Lisbor less two basis points
INTEREST PAYMENT FREQUENCY: First 14/9/97, then six-monthly,
modified following business day convention Act/365
LISTING: London PAYMENT AGENT: Morgan Guaranty
CLEARING: Euroclear, Cedel LEAD MANAGER: Banco Portugues de Investimento

Note - Frome is a financial investment company. The issuer has a call option which can be exercised either for tax reasons or for the bringing forward of the expiry of the return swap signed between the issuer and Morgan Guaranty.
